about: The brief of a result (reportBrief in shared/routine-result.ts): the one or two lines a routine's card shows, from the bot's own words, never a model call. from end: the closing line the run contract asks for (the last prose paragraph; run markers, code blocks, tables, headings and list items left out), or the first prose sentence when that line is shorter than 12 characters or ends with a colon. from start: the first sentence (a reply to another bot, the answer of a task a bot opened). A courtesy (an offer of more help or a sign-off to the reader, in English or French) is never the brief: the last prose before it is, and the first prose sentence when nothing comes before it. At most 200 characters, whole sentences, never cut inside a word, no Markdown. The same cases run on the server, the desktop and the phone.

cases.name: the closing line of a routine's report
cases.text:
Here is this morning's pass.

I read 14 new messages and filed 11 of them.

3 messages need you: two quotes to sign and one meeting to confirm.
cases.brief: 3 messages need you: two quotes to sign and one meeting to confirm.

cases.name: a long report with headings, tables and a list: the closing line, never a table row

Here is this evening's dispatch pass.

## Board state

| Board | Open | Unassigned |
|---|---|---|
| Service desk | 41 | 3 |
| Projects | 18 | 0 |

Three tickets waited on a client answer for more than five days; I sent the follow-up note on each one.

## Left alone

- #4790: the client asked to wait until Monday.
- #4801: the parts order is in transit.

Nothing else needs a decision tonight.
cases.brief: Nothing else needs a decision tonight.
